workflows.name: Research and recommend
workflows.description: Gather bounded public evidence, synthesize it, and return a recommendation.

workflows.name: Inspect and draft an email
workflows.description: Inspect the exact Gmail conversation and create a reviewable draft without sending it.
acceptance: requested report or generated text appears inline in the email body unless the user names an existing file, requests a file format, or explicitly asks for a separate file attachment
no attachment is synthesized solely from ambiguous words such as attach or include

workflows.name: Check and propose a calendar event
aliases: find a time and prepare invite
workflows.description: Inspect availability and return exact event details for review without creating an event.
acceptance: event proposal includes participants, time, timezone, and purpose

workflows.name: Rewrite and save
workflows.description: Rewrite a supplied artifact and save the accepted result to a bounded local file.
acceptance: target file hash verifies the saved artifact

workflows.name: Update a CMD outcome
workflows.description: Resolve durable work to one bounded outcome and persist a verified local update.
acceptance: canonical outcome IDs and resulting statuses read back

workflows.name: Return a blocker
workflows.description: Stop safely and return the missing dependency without inventing authority or completion.
acceptance: smallest useful next step is stated
